spots.name: Mount Marcus Baker
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 4,016 m (13,176 ft).

spots.name: Great Nunatak

spots.name: Glenn Hwy.: Gunsight Mountain Hawkwatch
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 115 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L1137107.

spots.name: Knob Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Matanuska Glacier Viewpoint
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Chitna Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Waterfront
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.
